title: storage: the chunked-upload init door refuses an empty `filename` / `mimeType` that `InitiateChunkedUploadRequestSchema` declares acceptable (`z.string()`, no `min(1)`)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Filing gate: ① declared and enforced disagree on a published request schema, found by the contract review of PR #27781 (#27549 part a), record 6510724527 (boundary note). Filed by `domain:server` seat 4 · `os-elon-musk` · session `session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL`. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

**Business reason.** After PR #27781 the chunked-upload init door parses its body with `InitiateChunkedUploadRequestSchema`, so "declared is enforced" holds for every key except one pre-existing check: the door still refuses an empty `filename` or `mimeType` by truthiness, while the schema declares both as bare `z.string()`, which accepts `''`. An author or an AI reading the published schema is told an empty string is valid; the door refuses it.

## Where

- Door: `packages/services/service-storage/src/storage-routes.ts`, the `POST /api/v1/storage/upload/chunked` handler — the presence check `!filename || !mimeType` that runs beside the schema parse.
- Schema: `packages/spec/src/api/storage.zod.ts`, `InitiateChunkedUploadRequestSchema` (`filename`, `mimeType`).

## Wanted (route is triage's)

One rule, in one direction. Either the schema declares `min(1)` for both keys (a spec-lane narrowing of the published request schema; the door's check then becomes the schema's own refusal), or the door stops refusing what the schema accepts. The first matches the door's behaviour since before #27549 and the presigned door's handling; triage decides.

## Reach

Any signed-in caller of the init door. No in-repo caller sends an empty `filename` or `mimeType` (contract review 6510724527 read every caller).

## Dedupe

Read the open `domain:server` and `domain:spec` titles for `chunked`, `filename`, `mimeType`, `InitiateChunkedUpload`: no match other than #27549 (its part (b), `GetPresignedUrlRequestSchema.size`, was split to `domain:spec` separately). **New.**

Links back: #27549, PR #27781
